beats.say: A pizza with a missing slice inspired the legendary arcade game Pac-Man.
In early 1979, designer Toru Iwatani began leading a nine-man team at Namco.
He wanted to create a game that appealed to both women and men.
He found his inspiration while looking at a simple pizza with a slice removed.
The game launched in Japan on 22 May 1980, originally titled Puck Man. Does this pizza origin story surprise you?

meta.title: Pac-Man: The pizza origin story 🍕
meta.summary: Discover how a pizza with a missing slice inspired the creation of the iconic arcade game Pac-Man by Toru Iwatani.
meta.comment: Did you know Pac-Man was inspired by a pizza?
facts: Pac-Man was designed by Toru Iwatani who led a nine-man team
The inspiration for the Pac-Man character was the image of a pizza with a slice removed
The game was released in Japan on 22 May 1980
The original Japanese title of Puck Man was derived from the phrase paku paku taberu
